title: Applied AI Engineer
description_html: The Opportunity  We are looking for a hands-on AI Agent Engineer to develop, build, and maintain intelligent agents that drive automation and business impact across the enterprise. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of agent development — from design to versioning, orchestration, and continuous learning.  You’ll contribute directly to scaling our AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring real-world performance in production environments.  What you'll Do   A core aspect of this role involves building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly enhance engineering efficiency, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.     Create reusable agent templates and modular components to accelerate deployment across business units  Productionize AI models from prototypes to production-ready systems.  Develop autonomous agents and skills for tasks like code generation and tool calling.  Optimize model performance, reduce latency, and improve reliability.  Implement prompt engineering strategies, memory handling, resource management and tool-calling integrations.   What you need to succeed   3–5+ years of experience in  AI/ML engineering and backend development   Prior exposure to LLM APIs or AI-powered services in production  Experience with AI tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or vector databases.  Ability to measure and improve model solve rates and accuracy.  Strong engineering fundamentals (Python, REST)  Experience with event streaming (Kafka, Flink, Kinesis, or similar) and data pipelines (Spark, Databricks, or comparable).  Familiarity with production operations: Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.  Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), REST APIs, Python, and containerization (Docker, K8s)      About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Backend API)
description_html:
Perplexity is looking for engineers who want to put planet-scale search in the hands of every developer and every agent. The API Platform is one of the fastest-growing surfaces of the company, and the team behind it owns all of it. The Search API, the Agent API, agent first SDKs, docs - from the request path to the developer experience. You'll work at the boundary where Perplexity's infrastructure meets the outside world, and you'll shape what that boundary looks like as agents become the dominant consumers of APIs.



We build with AI, for people who build with AI. If you spend your days working alongside frontier models and tooling, you already know where today's developer platforms fall short and that instinct is exactly what we're hiring for.



There are two ways into this team, and we're hiring for both: the product-minded API engineer who cares about schema design, SDK ergonomics, and a developer's first five minutes with the platform, and the infra-leaning platform engineer who cares about progressive delivery, observability, and keeping a high-traffic API stack fast and boringly reliable. The daily work mixes both - come in from whichever side is yours. 



What you'll do

 - Own critical APIs end to end: write the RFC, ship the implementation, roll it out from staging through canary to full fleet, and keep iterating after launch.

 - Contribute directly to product codebases across Go, Rust, Python.

 - Build the surfaces agents consume: hosted MCP, tool calling, connectors, and auth flows that let agents onboard and operate on their own.

 - Harden the platform for enterprise use: authentication patterns, data-handling guarantees, guardrails, and the security posture of a public API under real load.

 - Own what you run in production: monitors and dashboards as code, alerts that page you, postmortems you write and act on.

 - Partner with Research to evaluate frontier capabilities and turn the promising ones into production API features; work with Product, GTM, and customers directly to find the gaps between what builders need and what the platform offers today.

What we look for

 - Experience with designing and operating distributed, high-load systems.

 - Build with frontier models and tools - open source and closed source - every day, and you can walk us through your agentic workflow in detail.

 - High autonomy and agency, paired with real product sense: you think about developers and customers, what an API user wants next, and where the frontier is heading..

 - Working fluency with the core cloud infrastructure stack: a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, CI/CD.

 - Depth on at least one side of the role: API product craft or platform operations, and genuine interest in the other.

Nice to have

These are a bonus, not a requirement.

 - You've built your own agent loops or harnesses: the fastest way to stand out.

 - You've built developer or API tooling in the LLM ecosystem or in adjacent domains where API schemas evolve fast under real customer load, such as fintech or payments.

 - You've contributed to open-source SDKs, frameworks, or integrations that developers actually use.
$200K – $350K

title: Software Engineering AMTS (College Grad)
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.              Job Category          Software Engineering            Job Details                About Salesforce      Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.      Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. Apply now and we look forward to reaching out to you with opportunities that fit your background and interests! Must be located in North America  Academic, professional or internship experience working in a professional coding setting environment  Fluency in object-oriented programming/design  Academic, professional or internship experience in one of Java, Python, Javascript, HTML, SQL or C++      Even Better If...    Experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools   Ability to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes  Experience using Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini or other agent-based frameworks  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  Team-player with the ability to work effectively and efficiently with others  Be a self-starter and possess strong sense of self-motivation  Experience using telemetry and metrics to drive operational excellence        Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
